item.title: Version 1.29.0
item.description:
New

- Record More: Append additional screen recordings to an existing session directly from the timeline — add new clips without starting a new proejct - Screen Recording track type: New "Screen Recording" option in the Add Track modal to quickly record more content

Improved

- Add Track button: Redesigned timeline "Add Track" row with a visible dashed-border button instead of an invisible tap target - Multi-clip cursor handling: Cursor positions, spring simulations, click animations, and smart zooms are now tracked per-clip for accurate rendering across multi-clip sessions - Multi-clip export: Video compositor now correctly scales source buffers and isolates cursor/zoom data per clip during export - Recording failure handling: Consolidated error handling when recording fails to start — gracefully restores the editor if in "Record More" mode

Fixed

- Mobile device connection crash: Dispatched MobileDevice connection handling off the main thread to prevent UI blocking and potential crashes
